senses.gloss: m. (= גלגליד׳; גלד) slice; ג׳ דליפתא a slice of turnip, esp. the upper slice.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 43b">Bekh. 43ᵇ</cite> one whose head resembles <he>לגרגלידה דל׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>לגדגלידא</he>, corr. acc.) the upper portion &c. (expl. <cite ref="L00655"><he>לפתם</he></cite> ib. VII, 1).—Pl. <cite ref="C01253"><he>גַּרְגְּלִידֵי</he></cite>.
